text_block_list.text: After finishing our shopping for training supplies, Gentildonna and I were walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: How loud.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huh, sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You seem surprised.
I don't dislike testing my luck, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Having luck on your side
is also proof of being strong, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we were little, my siblings and I
would test our luck against one another in all sorts of ways.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: For example, with a pet alligator kept at an acquaintance's house... Oh, perhaps that was supposed to be a secret.
choice_data_list: (...I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's just that I'm not very familiar with lucky draws.
choice_data_list: Alright, wanna give it a shot?
Alright, wanna give it a try?

text_block_list.text:
From the shopping earlier,
I had been given exactly one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Let us take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still... what a remarkably flimsy lever.
My pinky finger alone is more than enough.

Gentildonna slowly turned the handle
of the raffle lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Behold the power of the strong.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, was the grand prize
a ticket for a hot spring trip?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You like hot springs,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I can go wherever I please,
whenever I want.
choice_data_list: Still... you probably won't go, will you?

text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna is remarkably stoic.
Even if she knows how to unwind, she won't take
a real break unless practically forced to.
choice_data_list: ...Let's think about why you won this ticket.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Because I won a test of luck.
That's all it is.
choice_data_list: No, maybe God is telling me to rest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
A god, you say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Even though I told you that I brought this upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, if so...
Could it be a matter of timing?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel.
In that case, do not borrow another's name—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Why don't you say it from your own perspective?

In other words... Gentildonna
might actually listen... if the words come from me
as her "Trainer".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
When the right time comes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then make sure you,
too, prepare thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. As my Trainer... you will let me rest plenty, won't you?

...When the time comes,
it seems I'll be shouldering a massive responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
First prize...
I suppose my luck held out.

What I won was the Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak...
I'd heard rumors about how popular it is among Umamusume.
Seeing it in person, though—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...It certainly has visual impact.
So you like this sort of thing too, I see."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As a sculpture,
I find it quite fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Pleasing the eyes is also an important element
of cooking, after all. But..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "If it's purely about appearances, then I'll pass."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Little lady, you look like quite the gourmet, but...
don't you worry, this Hamburg steak is top-notch!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I've energized all the Umamusume girls with these hamburg steaks!
Take a bite and you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...You are saying that in all seriousness, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...!!
O-Of course! I'm completely serious...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Then I shall partake.

And so... back at the academy,
I reheated the special carrot hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Could you call the chef for me?
I'd like to express my gratitude for such a wonderful flavor.

Afterward, I shared Gentildonna's thoughts with the shopping district folks over the phone...
We rejoiced together, feeling a strangely touching sense of emotion.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, so many.
It seems your luck isn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Looks like getting the nutrients I need won't be
a problem for a while.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should call for our private chef
to prepare a few dishes for us.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, do you cook?
Come to think of it, do you cook?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Which question are you asking?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you're asking if I *can* cook, yes.
If you're asking if I *will*, no.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Surrounded by professionals in this environment,
there's no point in doing it myself."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"And you?
Do you cook?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Then, would you take a few of these carrots with you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer,
you ought to have knowledge of dietary management as well."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Would you teach me about
a professional diet?"

"...Put that way,
my pride as a Trainer was stoked,
and I couldn't very well refuse."

—And so, the next day.
After doing my own research and thinking it over...
I brought along several dishes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...The nutritional balance seems flawless.
However, that is all it prioritizes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If one abandons flavor, it is no longer cooking.
Hardly the work of a professional, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...A food critic and a chef?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What, only this much?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So my luck...
boils down to a single carrot.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If that's the case—
(CRACK!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Please, you have some too.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: H-Holy crap... The carrot's split clean in two...

Looking at the carrot split perfectly in half, showing a cross-section so clean it looked as if it were cut with a knife...
I exchanged glances with the shopping district folks.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, a miss.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It is merely an entertainment.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Luck, too, is a form of strength—
and to have let it slip away...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...That doesn't sit well with me.

...It seems Gentildonna was a little—or rather,
quite a bit frustrated.
